name: checkbox
title: Checkbox
description: Checked, unchecked and indeterminate. Works for select-all rows.
htmlExample:
<label style="display:flex;gap:8px;align-items:center;font-size:14px"><bef-checkbox id="c1" default-checked></bef-checkbox> Email me updates</label>
<label style="display:flex;gap:8px;align-items:center;font-size:14px"><bef-checkbox id="c2"></bef-checkbox> Accept terms</label>
<label style="display:flex;gap:8px;align-items:center;font-size:14px"><bef-checkbox disabled></bef-checkbox> Disabled</label>
